'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Chris Schoenthal DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Chris Schoenthal]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''SoCal Sickle'''. Username '''imrahil327'''. Handwritten. DARK checked. Line 2 written Coruscant (SE); SE is a printing note, not (V). Line 18 is a struck name then According To My Design (V); the struck name is not entered. Line 36–37 written Victory → Victory-Class Star Destroyer. Line 41 written Black Leader → DS-61-2, box empty. Lines 45–47 written Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek, Secret Apprentice. Lines 51–52 written Cyborg Commander, Hunter of Jedi → Grievous, Hunter Of Jedi.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)]]
* '''Username:''' imrahil327
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
